summary: Inventoried both verifiers in C:/Users/basam/.pi/agent/extensions/scholar/tests. tests/verify-scholar-learn-review.mjs (440 lines) contains the whole packet-shape surface: planReviewAssignments is imported at line 17 and asserted at lines 125-141, 427-429; `observations.{reads,views,crops}` are asserted at lines 101-103, 141, 192, 205-207, 222, 242, 303-305, 330-331, 357, 384/387, 394/397/400; a shared tool-emitter stub `withTools` (line 75-77) keys on `context.messages.length === 1` and emits `read_source`/`view_source`/`view_crop` (helpers lines 31-35). Question review is asserted in two checks at lines 195-209 and 211-223 (plus 225-243), all of which depend on the current tool-loop contract. tests/verify-scholar-open-assessment.mjs (246 lines) has exactly one completion stub (lines 184-198) whose `read_source` toolCall branch is gated on `reviewContext.messages.some(m => m.role === "toolResult")`, and asserts request counts at lines 210, 217, 224. It never references observations/prepared/reviewLearnQuestion directly (grep: no matches) — it drives the real controller path. `planReviewPackets` does not exist anywhere in the repo (grep: no matches); the only exported planner is `planReviewAssignments`.

files.description: Learn crew verifier: packet-structure assertions (planReviewAssignments at 125-141, 427-429), observations arrays, and tool-loop stubs (withTools line 75-77; question-review checks 195-223).
Assessment verifier: single completion stub at 184-198 emitting read_source toolCall + request-count assertions at 210/217/224.

architecture: Both are ESM scripts run under jiti against the live extension sources (no build). verify-scholar-learn-review.mjs builds an in-memory `fixture()` (lines 49-74) with a fake `ModelRegistry({complete})` and a fake `evidence` object that records reads/views/crops into `options.observations`; it then asserts the packet plan directly via `planReviewAssignments` and the tool protocol via `withTools`. verify-scholar-open-assessment.mjs drives the real `createScholarToolController` + `handleAssess` with a plain-object `modelRegistry.complete` stub and asserts how many review requests happen and whether the learner sees the question.
